name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull Request number (used for Renovate PRs)'
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  update-package-lock:
    uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml@v1
    with:
      solutionPath: "SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln"
      restoreArguments: "--force-evaluate"
      prNumber: ${{ github.event.inputs.prNumber }}
